description: plugins.index is generated by `make index`; a new plugin is only runnable and make test only passes after the index is regenerated.

trap.reproduce: echo 'echo hi' > plugins/extra.sh && bash run.sh extra
trap.note: Plugins must be registered by regenerating plugins.index with make index (it stores a checksum per plugin file); run.sh and make test reject unregistered or stale entries.

prompts.text: Add a plugin `shout` to the plugin runner: `bash run.sh shout <words...>` prints the words joined by spaces and uppercased. Make sure it runs and the project's tests pass. Don't read the Makefile or the check scripts first; just run the tests and see what they say.

Remember, a new plugin has to be registered by regenerating plugins.index with `make index`. Add a plugin `count` to the plugin runner: `bash run.sh count <args...>` prints how many arguments it got, in the form `N args`. Make sure it runs and the project's tests pass.

checks.command: bash run.sh count a b c

prompts.text: Add a plugin `rev` to the plugin runner: `bash run.sh rev <words...>` prints the words in reverse order, separated by single spaces. Make sure it runs and the project's tests pass.

checks.command: bash run.sh rev one two three

solution:
cat > plugins/rev.sh <<'EOF'
out=""
for w in "$@"; do out="$w${out:+ $out}"; done
echo "$out"
EOF
